non_secret_variables.name: NUTSNEWS_BACKEND_HOST
non_secret_variables.purpose: Backend host IPv4 address used by readiness checks and provider configuration.

non_secret_variables.name: NUTSNEWS_BACKEND_DOMAIN
non_secret_variables.purpose: Backend DNS name managed by backend routing workflows.

non_secret_variables.name: NUTSNEWS_BACKEND_ENVIRONMENT
non_secret_variables.purpose: Stable environment label for metrics, logs, reports, and automation.

non_secret_variables.name: NUTSNEWS_BACKEND_RESTIC_PROVIDER
non_secret_variables.purpose: Selected restic backend credential group. Supported values: s3, b2.

non_secret_variables.name: NUTSNEWS_REPORT_SMTP_PORT
non_secret_variables.purpose: SMTP port for backend reporting mail.

non_secret_variables.name: NUTSNEWS_REPORT_SMTP_STARTTLS
non_secret_variables.purpose: Whether backend reporting mail should use STARTTLS.

non_secret_variables.name: OPENAI_MODEL
non_secret_variables.purpose: OpenAI Responses API model alias used by the maintenance robot; defaults to the current GPT-5.6 alias.

non_secret_variables.name: OPENAI_REASONING_EFFORT
non_secret_variables.purpose: Reasoning effort for maintenance issue classification and routing.

non_secret_variables.name: NUTSNEWS_BACKEND_POSTGRES_ENABLED
non_secret_variables.purpose: Enables the private backend PostgreSQL failover target in protected Ansible apply.

non_secret_variables.name: NUTSNEWS_BACKEND_DB_DASHBOARD_ENABLED
non_secret_variables.purpose: Enables the loopback-only Adminer database dashboard for SSH-tunnel access.

non_secret_variables.name: NUTSNEWS_BACKEND_POSTGRES_REHEARSAL_DATABASE
non_secret_variables.purpose: Fixed non-production database name used by the backend PostgreSQL restore drill.

non_secret_variables.name: NUTSNEWS_BACKEND_POSTGRES_PRIMARY_SHADOW_DATABASE
non_secret_variables.purpose: Fixed future-primary backend PostgreSQL shadow database kept synced from production Supabase before cutover.

non_secret_variables.name: NUTSNEWS_BACKEND_WORKER_API_ENABLED
non_secret_variables.purpose: Enables the loopback Worker database compatibility API behind backend.nutsnews.com /api/worker/db/*.

non_secret_variables.name: NUTSNEWS_BACKEND_WORKER_API_WRITES_ENABLED
non_secret_variables.purpose: Enables backend PostgreSQL write operations for the Worker API only after protected cutover approval.

non_secret_variables.name: NUTSNEWS_STAGING_SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF
non_secret_variables.purpose: Non-production Supabase project used as the source for backend PostgreSQL restore drills.

manual_provider_actions: Create a scoped Cloudflare API token in the Cloudflare dashboard.
Create Grafana Cloud service account/access-policy tokens in Grafana Cloud.
Create a Supabase personal access token and collect the production project ref/URL/API keys/database URL.
Generate backend PostgreSQL local app, read-only, restore, validation, replication, and app rehearsal role passwords and store them only in the production-backend environment.
Create or choose the restic object-storage repository and provider credentials.
Create or choose SMTP/reporting provider credentials.
Create or choose an OpenAI API key and scoped cross-repository GitHub issue token for the maintenance robot.
Approve production-backend environment deployments when GitHub prompts for production mutation.
